Images were spatially realigned to correct for head movement. Functional data were coregistered to the structural MPRAGE, which was then segmented into cerebrospinal fluid, gray matter, and white matter. Structural and functional images were then transformed into standardized stereotactic space as defined by the Montreal Neurological Institute.
